findings.evaluatorEvidence: "the same `terminate` binding B-12 declares is invoked and the step promise is awaited to settlement **before** the guardian rejection is rethrown unchanged" together with "`terminate` on a `reviewDir` with no mutation process registered yet is a no-op, so the wrap is safe whether or not the command has spawned", and B-12's "the bound covers the rejoin exit and the wrap covers the throw exits".
